active_set_policy: Read the current 64 active IDs from config/brand64-active-brands.json. The 2026-08-21 daily file contains the current active Brand64 set directly, including PAL IDs BR-00065..BR-00074, ZARA BR-00075 and SNIDEL BR-00076; no active overlay is required. Inactive legacy rows remain preserved in historical files and are excluded from the current active aggregation.
comparison_policy: Use the 2026-08-20 daily baseline for daily comparison. Do not claim no-change when product-level fields or source freshness are not comparable. Scheduled events after the 2026-08-21 08:29 JST observation time, including LOUNGEDRESS 12:00 and natural couture 20:00, are not treated as active until a later live observation confirms them. Official indexes/search results with non-live crawl timestamps may recover source coverage or create a baseline, but must not be treated as same-day launch, markdown, reservation-state, or stock change without a current product-page confirmation.
offline_policy: Never delete a known product when an official page becomes unavailable. Preserve last confirmed fields and mark SOURCE_OFFLINE with the last confirmed date.
conflict_policy: Do not overwrite a fresher baseline with stale or conflicting index/search values. Record SOURCE_STATE_CONFLICT and require a live product-page recheck.
dedupe_policy: Deduplicate by official product URL and manufacturer product code when available. If neither is available, use brand plus exact product title only as a temporary discovery key until the product page is captured.
brand_id_policy: Never reuse an inactive BR-ID for a new brand. Inactive brands remain INACTIVE_LEGACY_REFERENCE with history preserved.
